name: MCP Workflow Power Bundle 🤖 ☢️
description_md:
## What You Get

- 
Level 1 Ready-to-Run Docs: Step-by-step Claude Desktop + Remote MCP Server setup documentation—no guesswork, just follow along and launch.

- 
Instant Config JSONs: Copy-paste JSON files required for connecting n8n workflows, context7, and n8n MCP Servers—pulled straight from the exact screens you see in the preview.

- 
Direct GitHub Repo Links: One-click access to the public repositories for 1000s of n8n workflows, context7, and MCP servers.

- 
Tool List & Converter: Breakdown of the tools (like GitMCP) used to convert GitHub repos into live MCP workflows.

- 
Sample Agent Workflows: Ready-to-import agent workflow examples for your Claude Desktop or Cursor Knowledge Base—get started instantly, no coding needed.

If you want advanced Level 2/3 automations (including Docker setups, Cursor integrations, exclusive JSON bundles, and deep-dive templates), check out the Early AI-dopters Community
You won’t regret it 😉
